input.message: Hello support team. I am writing because I see very strange activity on my mobile account today. When I checked the app, I noticed a new device named 'Galaxy S24 Unknown' was added to my family plan yesterday night. Also, someone changed my main password and updated the recovery email to an address I do not know. Because of this, I see a charge for $45.00 for international data usage that I did not make. My wife asked me to also mention that our renewal date is next week, but I want to cancel my contract immediately as my top priority. Please process my cancellation and stop renewal first. The unauthorized access is scary, but my decision to leave the company is the most important thing now. I do not want to keep this line active anymore. Please confirm when my service will end and send final bill. Thank you for helping me close this account fast.

I received a system notice stating, 'Your SkyMiles account was accessed from an unknown device in Bangkok.' Although I travel often, I did not visit Thailand. Regardless of the cause, I now wish to cancel my membership entirely.

hey im a nurse just got off night shift and my brain is fried. saw an email alert saying someone logged into my photo cloud from a new device in ohio?? freaked out cuz i live in seattle. but then i texted my sister and she swore she didnt borrow my laptop. now im confused if it was her or some hacker. honestly this whole drama makes me not wanna use this anymore. pls cancel my subscription effective immediately. i dont care about the ohio login or the error codes anymore, just stop the renewal and close my account. the conflict between the alert and my sister is too much stress for my night shifts. just kill the plan thanks.
